question: What alternative sacred installation may be established together with a temple structure?
premises: A bāṇa-liṅga or similar object may be used.
This is presented as an alternative.
It may be accompanied by a temple structure.
inference: One may establish a bāṇa-liṅga or similar object together with a temple structure.
plain_english: Or one may establish a bāṇa-liṅga or the like, also accompanied by a temple.
